audience: engineering and support teams that publish incidents on Statuspage

useCases.title: Check what is broken now
useCases.text: List the unresolved incidents and the components with their status.

useCases.title: Review the uptime of a component
useCases.text: Read the uptime of a component for a period.

useCases.title: Prepare a post-incident review
useCases.text: List past incidents and open one to read its updates.

useCases.title: Open an incident
useCases.text: Create an incident with a name, a status and the affected components.

useCases.title: Post an update
useCases.text: Update an incident with a new status message, or set a component status.
